title: Database, Schema & Table Objects
description: Creating and managing databases, tables, schemas, sequences, synonyms, system databases, and table partitioning.
longDescription: This module covers the creation and management of databases, schemas, tables, and related objects in SQL Server. You'll learn how to create and drop databases and tables, manage schemas, work with sequences and synonyms, understand system databases, and implement table partitioning.
whatYouLearn: Create and drop databases using CREATE DATABASE and DROP DATABASE
Create tables with columns, data types, and constraints
Add, modify, and remove columns using ALTER TABLE
Create and manage schemas using ALTER SCHEMA and CREATE SCHEMA
Understand SQL Server system databases (master, msdb, model, tempdb)
Partition existing tables and create partitioned tables
Create and use SEQUENCE objects for generating numeric values
Use IDENTITY columns for auto-incrementing primary keys
Create synonyms as aliases for database objects
Grant permissions on database objects using GRANT
Add computed columns that derive values from other columns
